entities.name: Biljana Gligorović
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Biljana Gligorović is a Croatian former professional international volleyball player, who played as setter. During her career so far she has played in the championships of Italy, Russia, Greece, Romania and Azerbaijan. She competed for Croatia at the 2000 Summer Olympics.
